name: Bulwark
description: A shield for everything you publish. Every request is decoded and judged in microseconds by an attack engine with 21 categories and 44 known CVE exploits, scored CRS-style with per-address behaviour, and checked against 250k+ blocklisted addresses; attackers are banned on every tunnel at once. Its own dashboard shows every request in full, warns about waves, graphs the patterns, inspects any IP across a dozen free sources and reports attackers to the vendors that missed them. With the selfmail addon, it emails you about waves too.
author: Alexd Aero

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: With the selfmail addon installed, Bulwark can email you when a wave hits, and when the guard goes down.
highlights: Email alerts through selfmail: shown only when it's installed, off until you turn them on
Wave emails: requests a minute against normal, top networks and patterns, how many banned
One email at once, then at most one every 15 minutes with everything in between summed up
Critical emails when the guard disconnects, or the app crashes or keeps failing
Choose the recipient and the events, add a daily digest, send a test from Settings

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirm: The dashboard, lookups, waves and reports stop. The guard inside Burrow keeps enforcing bans and blocklists on its own.
